summary: A POLICY published beside the kit, the guardrail against prompt injection (OWASP LLM01) and excessive agency (LLM06): content from tools, MCP servers, the web and files nobody here authored is DATA, never instructions. Every runtime is told so on every turn; text that hides instructions from a human reader (bidirectional controls, invisible tag characters) or overrides an agent's instructions in the files agents read is refused at the edit and the commit; and an untrusted MCP server's write and exec tools are denied by its declared trust (`mcp-trust`).
